Converter general symbol. The qualifying symbol */* may be replaced by * // * to indicate electrical isolation. Asterisks: left=input, right=output. Indications: # digital, ∩ analogue, U/V voltage, f frequency, φ phase, I current, T temperature.
notes: The general qualifying symbols #/∩ and ∩/# may be replaced by DAC and ADC respectively.

symbols.description: Example: multiplying DAC (BIN/∩), device AD7545.
Example: ADC (∩/BIN), device AD673.
Example: voltage-to-frequency converter (U/f), device AD537.
Example: isolating d.c.-to-d.c. converter (U//U), device PM671P.
Voltage regulator general symbol. m1..mn represent the regulated voltages with respect to the common (0 V) terminal.

symbols.name_fr: Régulateur de tension positive à valeur de sortie fixe (par exemple LM309H)
symbols.description: Example: positive fixed voltage regulator (UREG, +5 V), device LM309H.

symbols.name_fr: Régulateur de tension positive ajustable (par exemple LM317T)
symbols.description: Example: positive adjustable voltage regulator (UREG, +1.25 V), device LM317T.
notes: Although the voltage between terminals 2 and 1 is fixed, an external network can give a different regulated voltage.
